+path=src/slatepress/html.py
+from typing import Optional
+
+def escape(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace('&', '&')
+    text = text.replace('<', '<')
+    text = text.replace('>', '>')
+    text = text.replace('"', '"')
+    text = text.replace("'", ''')
+    return text
+
+def page(title: str, body: str, css_link: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    parts = []
+    parts.append('<!DOCTYPE html>')
+    parts.append('<html>')
+    parts.append('<head>')
+    parts.append(f'<title>{escape(title)}</title>')
+    if css_link is not None:
+        parts.append(f'<link rel="stylesheet" href="{escape(css_link)}">')
+    parts.append('</head>')
+    parts.append('<body>')
+    parts.append('<main>')
+    parts.append(body)
+    parts.append('</main>')
+    parts.append('</body>')
+    parts.append('</html>')
+    return ''.join(parts)
+
